sections.indications_and_usage: Uses For the temporary relief of pain and itching associated with: insect bites minor cuts minor burns sunburn scrapes minor skin irritations rashes due to poison ivy, poison oak, or poison sumac
sections.dosage_and_administration: Direction Apply to affected area not more than 3 to 4 times daily Children under 2 years of age: do not use, consult a physician
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings For external use only. When using this produc t avoid contact with eyes If condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days, discontinue use of this product and consult a doctor.
sections.use_in_specific_populations: Adults and children 2 years of age and older:
